`@lucid-agents/catalog` turns a maintained YAML or CSV catalog into canonical
entrypoint registrations. It is useful when many products share one fulfillment
handler and differ mainly in schema, description, and price.

The package is currently available from the repository, not the Stable npm
channel. A Lucid catalog is application configuration; it does not publish to
x402 Bazaar and should not be described as marketplace discovery.

Use explicit validation at load time, reject duplicate keys, and keep the
catalog under the same review process as code. A price change is a commercial
API change even when it is only a YAML edit.

See the [catalog package reference](/docs/packages/catalog).
